record_title: Critical damping rigidity and logarithmic relaxation in the Thomas cyclic sine ring
provenance: Analytic Lyapunov, spectral, invariant-manifold, and asymptotic analysis of the cyclic Thomas sine-feedback system at its first pitchfork threshold.
limitations: The sharp relaxation law is for the unforced cyclic sine ring exactly at b=1. No novelty is claimed for the model, the strict b>1 stable regime, the pitchfork location, the higher-dimensional ring, or general invariant-manifold theory. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the 1999 Thomas article was not fully inspected at theorem level.
